🧭 Adventure

Exploration, spellcasting, study, and dangerous encounters around Hogwarts and beyond. 15 moves

Advance Time

🧭 Adventure reaction guide

This is the progress roll for the Time track, momentum is ignored on this roll.

When the track reaches 10, prepare to make this roll. Move on to a new Time Track.

On a strong hit, pick two, on a weak hit, pick one:

  • Gain +2 health, +2 spirit, or +2 reputation.
  • Remove a debility and take +1 health, spirit, or reputation.
  • Mark 1 spell in each category from your year as known.
  • Gain 1 XP.
  • On a mis, Pay the Price ↗. You have a wretched time in Hogwarts, something troubles you...

TODO: Button that rolls +0, then offers the choices.

Brew a Potion

🧭 Adventure action player

When you prepare a potion, write its name down and give it an appropriate rank. In general, students learn how to brew Dangerous potions starting in Year 3, Formidable in Year 5, and Extreme in Year 7. If a recipe has been researched, you can try brewing potions one rank higher at -2.

Envision which step you are taking (gathering ingredients, crushing, mixing, etc.), then, roll (skip creating a new track while you are still working on the same potion).

On a strong hit, mark progress. You manage to find the ingredients, or you successfully follow the correct brewing steps.

On a weak hit, you fail something, you breathe in a foul smell, you risk getting caught, or you burn yourself... Suffer -1 to momentum, spirit, health, or reputation.

On a mis, same as above, but you must choose to bottle your potion (you may no longer Brew a Potion ↗ to progress on this track), or discard it.

Cast

🧭 Adventure action player

When you cast a spell you Know outside of combat, roll +relevant skill. Take -2 for each year above, or +1 for each year below. You don't need to roll for learned spells 3 years below your own [Y4 -> Y1]. Add +2 if the spell is Learned.

If you cast a Charm, roll . If you cast a Defensive or Restorative Spell, roll . If you cast Dark Arts: Jinxes (instant effect), Hexes (short-term effect), or Curses (long-term effect), roll . If you cast Transfiguration spell (very short range), roll .

On a strong hit, the spell is successful, envision what happens and gain +1 momentum. You may use the occasion to Learn a Spell ↗.

On a weak hit, you cast the spell, but (pick one)...

  • The effect isn't as powerful as it should be.
  • The effect doesn't last as long as it should.
  • You attract unwanted attention.

On a miss, Pay the Price ↗. The spell misses (lose momentum), backfires (Endure Harm or Stress), draws attention (Get Caught ↗)...

Face Danger

🧭 Adventure action guide

When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  • With speed, agility, or precision: Roll .
  • With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll .
  • With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll .
  • With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll .
  • With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll .

On a strong hit, you are successful. Take +1 momentum.

On a weak hit, you succeed, but face a troublesome cost. Choose one:

  • You are delayed, loose advantage, or face a new danger: Suffer -1 momentum.
  • You are tired or hurt: Endure Harm ↗ (1 harm).
  • You are dispirited or afraid: Endure Stress ↗ (1 stress).
  • You Get Caught ↗ (1 reputation).

On a mis, you fail, or your progress is undermined by a dramatic and costly turn of events. Pay the Price ↗.

Gather Information

🧭 Adventure action player

When you search an area, ask questions, conduct an investigation, or follow a track, roll . If you act within a community or ask questions of a person with whom you share a bond, add +1.

On a strong hit, you discover something helpful and specific. The path you must follow or action you must take to make progress is made clear. Envision what you learn (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and take +2 momentum.

On a weak hit, the information complicates your quest or introduces a new danger. Envision what you discover (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and take +1 momentum.

On a mis, your investigation unearths a dire threat or reveals an unwelcome truth that undermines your quest. Pay the Price ↗.

Go to the Hospital Wing

🧭 Adventure action player

When you are hurt and go to the Hospital Wing, make progress on the Time track. Heal 2 and suffer -1 momentum. If you are Wounded, you may instead mark progress twice on the Time track to remove the Wounded condition.

TODO: Button that marks progress of the time track of selected character, increased health my 2, and removes 1 momentum. Option to mark two progress to remove Wounded condition.

Interact

🧭 Adventure action player

When you interact with an object or point of interest.

Investigate

🧭 Adventure action player

When you investigate an object you learn more about a particular Point of Interest.

On a strong hit, you discover something helpful and specific. Ask 2 questions.

On a weak hit, the information isn't very specific, or you might miss a detail. Ask 1 question.

On a miss, you learn nothing useful and might have missed an important detail.

Some questions you could ask...

  • Are there any traps?
  • Is there any remaining magic here?
  • Is there anything strange, physically about this?
  • Is this similar to something I've seen before?
  • Is there anything of use here?
  • Or ask anything else...

Know Something

🧭 Adventure action player

When you think it's reasonable that you might have read about something or that you know a spell, roll .

For spells in your year, add +1 for every four months of school passed. (+1 in January, +2 in May).

Add +3 for earlier years (all spells 3 years below count as Known and do not need to be rolled).

On a strong hit, you Know the spell well, or you've read something useful.

On a weak hit, you don't Know the spell, or you've read something that will make things hard.

On a miss: You think you Know the spell, but you don't. Cast it as a -3. You haven't read about that.

Learn a Spell

🧭 Adventure reaction guide

When you learn a spell in class, with a mentor or through your own means, or when you practice a spell you Know, roll +relevant skill. Take -2 for each year above, or +1 for each your below.

On a strong hit, choose: Mark a Known spell as Learned and get +2 momentum, or mark an unknown spell as Learned.

On a weak hit, choose: Mark a Known spell as Learned but take -2 momentum, or mark an unknown spell as Known.

On a mis, Pay the Price ↗. The spell backfires spectacularly, you get frustrated, you get caught learning a forbidden spell...

TODO: Button that rolls for selected skill. Also include the year bonus of debuff.

Move

🧭 Adventure action player

When you move you may move 3 spaces in any direction. You may interrupt your movement to perform another action.

Pass your Exams

🧭 Adventure reaction guide

This is the progress roll for the Academic track, momentum is ignored on this roll. Reset your Health for the next year.

On a strong hit: Outstanding work!

  • Mark +3XP. reset your reputation and spirit
  • Mark 3 spells from the year you are ending as Learned
  • Mark 3 spells from the year you are starting as Known.

On a weak hit: You can do better. Pick one from above, then Ensure Stress (1 stress).

On a mis: Dreadful results. Get Caught ↗ -2, you should considering studying over summer. Don't forget to check if you Win the House Cup ↗ at the end of the year.

Secure an Advantage

🧭 Adventure action player

When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  • With speed, agility, or precision: Roll .
  • With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll .
  • With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll .
  • With deception, stealth, trickery, or divination: Roll .
  • With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll .

On a strong hit, take both. One a weak hit, choose one.

  • Take +2 momentum.
  • Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move).

On a mis, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price ↗.

Study

🧭 Adventure action player

When you study outside of class, roll +wit.

On a strong hit, mark progress on the Academic t rack and add +1 the next time you Attend Class ↗.

On a weak hit, pick one:

  • gain +1 momentum
  • gain +2 momentum at the cost of 1 Stress.

On a mis, you overwork yourself or something bothersome interrupts you. Pay the Price ↗.

Use a Potion

🧭 Adventure action player

When you use a potion you created, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress on the Potion's track. Momentum is ignored on this roll.

On a strong hit, the potion works as intended.

On a weak hit, the potion mostly works, but it has a side effect or is less potent than intended. Take -1 momentum.

On a miss, the potion was not prepared as it should, something goes horribly wrong. Pay the Price ↗.

⚔️ Combat

Duels, skirmishes, clashes, and tactical spell combat against adversaries. 7 moves

Battle

⚔️ Combat action player

When you fight a battle, and it happens in a blur, envision your objective and roll. If you primarily...

  • Fight at range, or using your speed and the terrain to your advantage: Roll .
  • Fight depending on your courage, allies, or companions: Roll .
  • Fight in close to overpower your opponents: Roll .
  • Right using trickery to befuddle your opponents: Roll .
  • Fight using careful tactics to outsmart your opponents: Roll .

On a strong hit, you achieve your objective unconditionally. Take +2 momentum.

On a weak hit, you achieve your objective, but not without cost. Pay the Price ↗.

On a miss, you are defeated and the objective is lost to you. Pay the Price ↗.

Clash

⚔️ Combat action player

When your foe has initiative and you fight with them in close quarters, roll . When you exchange a volley at range, or shoot an advancing foe, roll . If using spells, use Spell Combat ↗.

On a strong hit, inflict your harm and choose one. You have the initiative.

  • You bolster your position: Take +1 momentum.
  • You find an opening: Inflict +1 harm.

On a weak hit, inflict your harm, but then Pay the Price ↗. Your foe has initiative.

On a miss, you are outmatched and must Pay the Price ↗. Your foe has initiative.

End the Fight

⚔️ Combat action player

When you take decisive action to resolve the outcome of this fight, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress. Momentum is ignored on this roll.

If you do not have initiative, count a strong hit as a weak hit, and weak hit as a miss.

On a strong hit, this foe is no longer in the fight. They are killed, out of action, flee, or surrender as appropriate to the situations and your intent (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure).

On a weak hit, as above, but you must also choose one.

  • It's worse than you thought: Endure Harm ↗.
  • You are overcome: Endure Stress ↗.
  • Your victory is short-lived: A new danger or foe appears, or an existing danger worsens.
  • You suffer collateral damage: Something of value is lost or broken, or someone important must pay the cost.
  • You'll pay for it: An objective falls out of reach.
  • Others won't forget: You are marked for vengeance.

On a mis, you have lost this fight. Pay the Price ↗.

Enter the Fray

⚔️ Combat action player

When you enter into combat, set the rank of each of your foes.

  • Troublesome foe: 3 progress per harm.
  • Dangerous foe: 2 progress per harm.
  • Formidable foe: 1 progress per harm.
  • Extreme foe: 2 ticks per harm.
  • Epic foe: 1 tick per harm.

Then, roll to determine who is in control. If you are...

  • Facing off against your foe: Roll .
  • Moving into position against an unaware foe, or striking without warning: Roll .
  • Ambushed: Roll .

On a strong hit, take +2 momentum. You have initiative.

On a weak hit, choose on.

  • Bolster your position: Take +2 momentum.
  • Prepare to act: Take initiative.

On a miss, combat begins with you at a disadvantage. Pay the Price ↗. Your foe has initiative.

Spell Combat

⚔️ Combat action player

When you use a move in combat by casting spells you Know. Proceed with the move as usual, but roll +relevant to the spell type (note you may use a single move to represent multiple spells, use the stat you feel most relevant if multiple types are used).

Cast Known spells at -1. Damaging spells cause 2 harm, whereas non-spell damage causes 1 harm.

Transfigurating an enemy is a rather powerful move, so consider doing so on your last enemy only when you are ready to End the Fight ↗. You could only still use transfiguration strategically on other items or insuspecting animals to Secure an Advantage ↗ or Face Danger ↗, or if faces with several enemies.

Strike

⚔️ Combat action player

When you have initiative and attack on close quarters, roll . When you have initiative and attack at range, roll . If using spells, use Spell Combat ↗.

On a strong hit, inflict +1 harm. You retain initiative.

On a weak hit, inflict your harm and lose initiative.

On a mis, your attack fails and you must Pay the Price ↗. Your foe has initiative.

Turn the Tide

⚔️ Combat action player

Once per fight, when you risk it all, you may steal initiative from your foe to make a move (not a progress move). When you do, add +1 and take +1 momentum on a hit.

If you fail to score a hit on that move, you must suffer a dire outcome. Pay the Price ↗.

🏰 Hogwarts Life

Attending classes, brewing potions, hospital wing recovery, and student routines. 1 moves

Attend Class

🏰 Hogwarts Life action player

Mark progress on time track, then roll the relevant skill. If you are studying a spell, you can roll to Learn a spell ↗, even on a miss.

On a strong hit, mark progress on the Academic track, envision the scene and pick the most relevant:

  • Add +1 if you roll to Learn a spell
  • Brew a potion +1, using the ingredients provided. You get to keep it when it is done. (Take brewing length into consideration)
  • Get +2 reputation
  • Get +2 momentum
  • Get +1 to Forge a bond ↗ with teacher or partner

On a weak hit, class doesn’t go as planned. Ask the Oracle ↗ to see what happened and play out the scene. If you manage to get things back on track, mark progress on the academic track.

On a miss, envision what went wrong and Pay the Price.

📜 Quests & Mysteries

Investigating mysteries, gathering clues, advancing tracks, and solving enigmas. 3 moves

Advance

📜 Quests & Mysteries reaction guide

When you focus on your skills, receive training, find inspiration, earn a reward, or gain a companion you may spend 3 experience to add a new asset, or 2 experience to upgrade an asset.

Investigate a Mystery

📜 Quests & Mysteries action guide

When you want to solve a mystery or are tasked with a quest, write down the mystery or quest and give it a rank. Then roll . If solving it will help a person or community with whom you share a bond, add +1.

On a strong hit, you are emboldened and it is clear what you must do next (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure). Take +2 momentum.

On a weak hit, you are determined but begin your quest with more questions than answers. Take +1 momentum, and envision what you do to find a path forward.

On a miss, you face a significant obstacle before you can begin your quest. Envision what stands in your way (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and choose one.

  • You press on: Suffer -2 momentum, and do what you must to overcome this obstacle.
  • You give up: Pay the Price ↗.

Solve a Mystery

📜 Quests & Mysteries reaction guide

When you reach what you believe to be the conclusion of a mystery, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress. Momentum is ignored on this roll.

On a strong hit, your mystery is solved or your quest complete. Mark experience (troublesome=1; dangerous=2; formidable=3; extreme=4; epic=5).

On a weak hit, there is more to be done or you realize the truth of your quest. Envision what you discover (Ask the Oracle if unsure). Then, mark experience (troublesome=0; dangerous=1; formidable=2; extreme=3; epic=4). You may Investigate a Mystery to set things right. If you do, add +1.

On a miss, your investigation or quest was in vain. Envision what happens (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and choose one.

  • You recommit: Clear all but one filled progress, and raise the mystery’s rank by one (if not already epic).
  • You give up: Pay the Price ↗.

🤝 Relationships

Aiding allies, compelling others, forging bonds, common room downtime, and the House Cup. 6 moves

Aid your Ally

🤝 Relationships reaction guide

When you Secure an Advantage ↗ in direct support of an ally, and score a hit, they (instead of you) can take the benefits of the move. If you are in the combat and score a strong hit, you and your ally have initiative.

Compel

🤝 Relationships action player

When you attempt to persuade someone to do something, envision your approach and roll. If you...

  • Charm, pacify, barter, or convince: Roll (add +1 if you share a bond).
  • Threaten or incite: Roll .
  • Lie or swindle: Roll .

On a strong hit, they'll do what you want or share what they know. Take +1 momentum. If you use this exchange to Gather Infornation, make that move now, and add +1.

On a weak hit, as above, but they ask something of you in return. Envision what they want (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure).

On a miss, they refuse or make a demand which costs you greatly. Pay the Price ↗.

Forge a Bond

🤝 Relationships action player

When you spend significant time with a person or community, stand together to face hardships, or make sacrifices for their cause, you can attempt to create a bond. When you do, roll . If you make this move after you successfully Solve a Mystery ↗ to their benefit, you may reroll any dice.

On a strong hit, make note of the bond, mark progress on your bond progress track, and choose one.

  • Take +1 spirit
  • Take +2 momentum
  • Take +1 reputation (if bonded with a member of Hogwarts' staff.)

On a weak hit, they ask something more of you first. Envision what it is (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), do it (or Investigate a Mystery ↗), and mark the bond. If you refuse or fail, Pay the Price ↗.

On a mis, they reject you. Pay the Price ↗.

Spend Time in the Common Room

🤝 Relationships action player

When you rest in the warmth of your Common Roo, roll . If with someone with whom you share a bond, add +1.

On a strong hit, you and your allies may each pick two.

On a weak hit, you and your allies may each pick one:

  • Recuperate: Take for you and any companions.
  • Be Raucous: Suffer -1 reputation and take +2 spirit.
  • Relax: Take +1 spirit.
  • Focus: Take +1 momentum.
  • Prepare: When you Secure an Advantage ↗, add +1.

On a miss, something happens while you are in the common room, or as you are heading there. Pay the Price ↗. Perhaps a housemate asks something of you or a mysterious even happens.

Test your Bond

🤝 Relationships reaction guide

When your bond is tested through conflict, betrayal, or circumstance, roll .

On a strong hit, this test has strengthened your bond. Choose one.

  • Take +1 spirit.
  • Take +2 momentum.

On a weak hit, your bond is fragile and you must prove your loyalty. Envision what they ask of you (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and do it (or Investigate a Mystery ↗). If you refuse or fail, clear the bond and Pay the Price ↗.

On a miss, or if you have no interest in maintaining this relationship, clear the bond and Pay the Price ↗.

Win the House Cup

🤝 Relationships action player

At the end of every school year, the House Cup winners are announced, roll the challenge dice and compare to your bonds. Momentum is ignored on this roll.

On a strong hit, your House has won the House Cup! Reset your spirit track and take +1 XP. Reset your bonds tracker to 0.

On a weak hit, your House put up a good effort. Start the next Year with 2 progress marked.

On a miss, your House is dead last. Endure Stress ↗ (1), but don't reset your bonds tracker (keep 5 progress max).

⏳ Scene Challenge

High-stakes scenes, Quidditch matches, countdown segments, and rapid resolution. 5 moves

Begin the Scene

⏳ Scene Challenge action guide

When you face an extended or complex challenge, name your objective and choose a rank as appropriate to the situation.

  • You have a clear advantage: Troublesome
  • You are ready to act: Dangerous
  • You are unprepared or outmatched: Formidable.

Then, activate a four segment countdown track and Face Danger ↗ or Secure an Advantage ↗ to take action.

Face Danger

⏳ Scene Challenge action guide

When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  • With speed, agility, or precision: Roll .
  • With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll .
  • With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll .
  • With deception, stealth, or trickery: Roll .
  • With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll .

On a strong hit, you are successful and mark progress. On a strong hit with a match, mark progress twice.

On a weak hit, you are successful and mark progress, but also encounter a complication or setback. Envision what occurs and mark a countdown segment.

On a miss, you fail, or a momentary success is undermined by a dramatic turn of events. Mark a countdown segment and Pay the Price ↗. On a miss with a match, mark two segments and Pay the Price ↗.

Finish the Scene

⏳ Scene Challenge reaction guide

When the scene challenge countdown track or progress track is filled, or when events lead to the scene's conclusion, roll the challenge dice and compare your progress.

On a strong hit, you achieve your objective unconditionally.

On a weak hit, you succeed, but not without a cost. You must Pay the Price ↗. Make this a minor cost relatively to the scope of the scene.

On a mis, you fail or are undetermined by a dire turn of events. Pay the Price ↗.

Play Quidditch

⏳ Scene Challenge action player

To play Quidditch, start a scene challenge, setting the rank to Dangerous, unless the teams are seriously lopsided. Use Face Danger ↗ and Secure an Advantage ↗ using the appropriate stat. Not all rolls should be of course; you could use heart to plunge towards the ground and pull up at the last second, commit a foul unseen using cunning, use power to knock a bludger into the opposing Seeker, etc.

When you Finish the Scene ↗, the snitch has been caught and the game is over.

On a strong hit, your team wins.

On a weak hit, either your team loses but you played well, or your yeam wins, but must Pay the Price ↗.

On a miss, you lose dramatically, Pay the Price ↗.

Alternatively, for shorter games, you can use the Battle ↗ move to resolve the match in one roll. Use the appropriate stat for your position as defined page 5. You could also roll if you shared a strategy with the team and they use it (even if you aren't on the team), or if you are the team captain.

Secure an Advantage

⏳ Scene Challenge action player

When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage, envision your action and roll. If you act...

  • With speed, agility, or precision: Roll .
  • With charm, loyalty, or courage: Roll .
  • With aggressive action, forceful defense, strength, or endurance: Roll .
  • With deception, stealth, trickery, or divination: Roll .
  • With expertise, insight, or observation: Roll .

On a strong hit, take both. On a strong hit with a match, take both and mark progress.

On a weak hit, choose one.

  • Take +2 momentum.
  • Add +1 on your next move (not a progress move)

On a miss, you fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price ↗. On a miss with a match, mark two segments and Pay the Price ↗.

💔 Suffer & Harm

Enduring physical harm, mental stress, getting caught by teachers, setbacks, and death. 8 moves

Companion Endure Harm

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When your companion faces physical damage, they suffer -health equal to the amount of harm inflicted. If your companion's health is 0, exchange any leftover -health for -momentum. Then roll or +your companion's health, whichever is higher.

On a strong hit, your companion rallies. Give them +1 health.

On a weak hit, your companion is battered. If their health is 0, they cannot assist you until they gain at least +1 health.

On a miss, also suffer -1 momentum. If your companion's health is 0, they are gravely wounded and out of action. Without aid, they die in an hour or two. If you roll a miss with a 1 on your action die, and your companion's health it 0, they are now dead. Take 1 experience for each marked ability on your companion asset, and remove it.

Endure Harm

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When you face physical damage, suffer -health as appropriate to the situations. If your health is 0, suffer -momentum equal to any remaining health. Then roll , or , whichever is higher.

On a strong hit, choose one.

  • Shake it off: If your health is greater than 0, suffer -1 momentum in exchange for +1 health.
  • Embrace the pain: Take +1 momentum.

On a weak hit, you press on.

On a miss, also suffer -1 momentum. If you are at 0 health, you must mark Wounded or Maimed (if currently unmarked) or roll on the following table.

📜 Table Reference
Roll Result
1-10 The harm is mortal. Face Death ↗.
11-20 You are dying. You need healing within an hour or two, or Face Death ↗.
21-35 You are unconscious and out of action. If left alone, you come back to your senses in an hour or two. If you are vulnerable to a foe not inclined to show mercy, Face Death ↗.
36-50 You are reeling and fighting to stay conscious. If you engage in any vigorous activity (such as running or fighting) before taking a breather for a few minutes, roll on this table again (before resolving the other move).
51-100 You are battered but still standing.

Endure Stress

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When you face mental shock or despair, suffer -spirit as appropriate to the situation. If you spirit is 0, suffer -momentum equal to any remaining -spirit.

Then roll or , whichever is higher.

On a strong hit, choose one.

  • Shake it off: If your spirit is greater than 0, suffer -1 momentum in exchange for .
  • Embrace the darkness: Take +1 momentum.

On a weak hit, you press on.

On a miss, also suffer -1 momentum. If you are at 0 spirit, you must mark shaken or corrupted (if currently unmarked) or roll on the following table.

📜 Table Reference
Roll Result
1-10 You are overwhelmed. Face Desolation ↗.
11-25 You give up. Abandon a Mystery (if possible, one relevant to your current crisis). And Pay the Price ↗.
26-50 You give in to a fear or compulsion, and act against your better instincts.
51-100 You persevere.

Face a Setback

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When your momentum is at its minimum (-6), and you suffer additional -momentum, choose one.

  • Exchange each additional -momentum for any combination of -health, -spirit, or -reputation as appropriate to the circumstances.
  • Envision an event or discovery (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure) which undermines your progress in a current quest, journey or fight. Then, for each additional -momentum, clear 1 unit of progress on that track per its rank.

Face Death

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When you are brought to the brink of death, and glimpse the world beyond, roll .

On a strong hit, death rejects you. You are cast back into the mortal world.

On a weak hit, choose one.

  • You die, but not before making a noble sacrifice. Envision your final moments.
  • Death desires something of you in exchange for your life. Envision what it wants (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and Investigate a Mystery ↗ (formidable or extreme) to complete that quest. If you fail to score a hit when you Investigate a Mystery ↗, or refuse the quest, you are dead. Otherwise, you return to the mortal world and are now cursed. You may only clear the cursed debility by completing the quest.

On a mis, you are dead.

Face Desolation

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When you are brought to the brink of desolation, roll .

On a strong hit, you resist and press on.

On a weak hit, choose one.

  • Your spirit or sanity breaks, but not before you make a noble sacrifice. Envision your final moments.
  • You see a vision of a dreaded event coming to pass. Envision that dark future (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure), and Investigate a Mystery ↗ (formidable or extreme) to prevent it. If you fail to score a hit when you Investigate a Mystery ↗, or refuse the request, you are lost. Otherwise, you return to your senses and are now tormented. You may only clear the tormented debility by completing the quest.

On a miss, you succumb to despair or horror and are lost.

Find a Clue

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When you make a significant progress in solving a mystery by overcoming a critical obstacle, completing a perilous journey, finding an important clue, defeating a powerful threat, gaining vital support, or acquiring a crucial item, you may mark progress.

  • Troublesome quest: Mark 3 progress.
  • Dangerous quest: Mark 2 progress.
  • Formidable quest: Mark 1 progress.
  • Extreme quest: Mark 2 ticks.
  • Epic quest: Mark 1 tick.

Get Caught

💔 Suffer & Harm reaction guide

When you get caught and lose reputation, roll or , whichever is higher. If your reputation is 0, suffer -momentum equal to any remaining -reputation.

On a strong hit, pick one:

  • They are lenient. Take -1 momentum for +1 reputation.
  • It was worth it. Take +1 momentum.

On a weak hit, you are scolded, your house may lose a few points. Carry on.

On a miss, suffer -1 momentum. If you are at 0 rep, you must mark Notorious (if current unmarked) or roll on the following table.

📜 Table Reference
Roll Result
1-10 You face expulsion, play out the scene with the Headmaster.
11-25 Your punishment is cruel and time-consuming, mark progress on the Time Track.
26-50 You get detention and are viewed as a troublemaker.
51-100 You only loose House Points.

🔮 Fate & Oracle

Asking the oracle yes/no questions and paying the price when fortune turns sour. 2 moves

Ask the Oracle

🔮 Fate & Oracle action guide

When you seek to resolve questions, discover details in the world, determine how other characters respond, or trigger encounters or events, you may…

  • Draw a conclusion: Decide the answer based on the most interesting and obvious result.
  • Ask a yes/no question: Decide the odds of a ‘yes’, and roll on the table below to check the answer.
  • Pick two: Envision two options. Rate one as ‘likely’, and roll on the table below to see if it is true. If not, it is the other.
  • Spark an idea: Brainstorm or use a random prompt.
📜 Table Reference
Odds The answer is 'yes' if you roll...
Almost certain 11 or greater
Likely 26 or greater
50/50 51 or greater
Unlikely 76 or greater
Small chance 91 or greater
On a match, an extreme result or twist has occured.

Pay the Price

🔮 Fate & Oracle reaction guide

When you suffer the outcome of a move, choose one.

  • Make the most obvious negative outcome happen.
  • Envision two negative outcomes. Rate one as 'likely' and Ask the Oracle ↗ using the yes/no table. On a 'yes', make that outcome happen. Otherwise, make it the other.
  • Roll on the following table. If you have difficulty interpreting the result to fit the current situation, roll again.
📜 Table Reference
Roll Result
1-2 Roll again and apply that result but make it worse. If you roll this result yet again, think of something dreadful that changes the course of your quest (Ask the Oracle ↗ if unsure) and make it happen.
3-5 A person or community you trusted loses faith in you, or acts against you.
6-9 A person or community you care about is exposed to danger.
10-16 You are separated from something or someone.
17-23 Your action has unintended effect.
24-32 Something of value is lost or destroyed.
33-41 The current situation worsens.
42-50 A new danger or foe is revealed.
51-59 It causes a delay or puts you at a disadvantage.
60-68 It is harmful.
69-76 It is stressful.
77-85 A surprising development complicates your quest.
86-90 Your reputation suffers.
91-94 It forces you to act against your best intentions.
95-98 A friend, companion, or ally is put in harm's way (or you are, if alone).
99-100 Roll twice more on this table. Both results occur. If they are the same result, make it worse.
